items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: Johnny Fisher played there not much. No. I don't know. I thought he would. No, I don't.

ctx.x: You know any other band that played over the river? Fisher played over there, didn't he?
Johnny Fisher played there not much. No. I don't know. I thought he would. No, I don't. Outside of Johnny Fisher. No. I don't.
Did you ever hear of a band, a colored band over there by the name of Minetta Band?
